description: Return who this MCP credential acts as: principal email/role, agent name, client (Claude install) that issued the token, and when it was last used. Works for br_ik_* instance keys, br_oat_* OAuth tokens and signing keys; OAuth-specific fields are null when called under a key. For a key no human owns it also returns next_step, which says what to do next.
name: auth_whoami
title: Auth whoami
